sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: jumps, near-misses and air time all count. Chain stunt jumps on the long highways and causeways to build the total fast.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges: learn each weapon's recoil, aim for the head zones, and retry a challenge until the gold threshold clears.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
